entries.zh: 把过错转嫁给他人；诿过于人
entries.en: to shift the blame onto another; to pass one's fault on to others
entries.notes: 汉栏「聞乞人」字形与诿过义不直接相应，释义据西语词头 traspassar la culpa a otro 及'V乞人（给/让）'句式推断。

entries.zh: 累人：连累他人、使人受牵累
entries.en: to implicate others; to involve others in one's fault

entries.zh: 拖累：牵连拖害，使他人受累
entries.en: to drag down; to encumber; to implicate others

entries.zh: 抛害：把祸害抛给他人、加害于人
entries.en: to cast harm upon another; to throw misfortune or blame onto others

entries.zh: 相累：互相牵累、彼此受累
entries.en: to implicate one another; mutual encumbrance

entries.zh: 相移：互相推转、彼此移卸（责任）
entries.en: to shift (blame) onto one another; to pass over mutually

entries.zh: 移累：把牵累移转于他人
entries.en: to transfer the burden or implication to another

entries.zh: 贻谋：把计谋留授他人；遗留谋划
entries.en: to pass a scheme on to another; to bequeath one's plans
entries.notes: 「贻谋」经典义为'为后人留谋'，与本页'转嫁罪责'词头的衔接存疑，音档 y-bou 与字相合。

entries.zh: 把债务转给他人；转嫁债务
entries.en: to transfer the debt to another (person)
entries.notes: 汉栏[残]仅存「對過」，音档三音节与两字不合；释义据完整西语词头 traspassar la deuda a otro 定。

entries.zh: 把债务转过去、转给他人
entries.en: to pass the debt over to another
entries.notes: 汉栏[残]仅存「過去」，释义据西语词头与所存汉字推断。

entries.zh: 对还：转由他人偿还；抵还
entries.en: to have another repay the debt; to settle by charging it to another
entries.notes: 「對還」取'兑还、转由他人抵偿'之义，与'转债他人'词头的衔接系推断。

entries.zh: 对数：把账目对入他人账下；对账、结账（数＝账目/债）
entries.en: to put the debt on another's account; to check and settle accounts

entries.zh: 对过：把债务转过他人名下；过账
entries.en: to transfer the debt across to another's account

entries.zh: 布：铺放、布设；移置他处
entries.en: to spread, to lay out; to place or move to another place
entries.notes: 单字「布」与词头'移植并移往他处'(trasplantar y pasarlo a otro lugar) 的对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 徙：迁移、移居；移植（他处）
entries.en: to move, to relocate; to transplant

entries.zh: 栽：栽种、移植（草木）
entries.en: to plant; to transplant (a tree or plant)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:栽/裁]形近未定，据音 chay 与词头'移植'取「栽」；西语词头 otalica 疑为残词。

entries.zh: 蒔：插秧、移插秧苗（移植水稻）
entries.en: to transplant rice seedlings; to set out rice

entries.zh: 布秧：铺置秧苗、播秧
entries.en: to lay out rice seedlings; to sow the seedlings

entries.zh: 布柿：播种撒籽（「柿」疑为「籽」之讹）
entries.en: to sow or scatter seed; lit. 'spread persimmon' (柿 likely corrupt for 籽 'seed')
entries.notes: 字面「布柿」与'移植水稻'词头不合，语义无法定夺，取播种义并标存疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
